legal.title: About, Privacy & Terms
legal.sectionDesc: Privacy guidelines (LGPD/GDPR), copyright disclosures, age compliance, and contact channel.
legal.aboutText: AniMatch is an independent, 100% free and non-commercial tool for personal anime discovery and cataloging. Metadata, covers, and synopses are loaded from the public APIs of AniList, Kitsu, and MyAnimeList for strictly informational use. All trademarks, titles, and images belong to their respective owners and streaming services, without any official affiliation or endorsement.
legal.privacyText: We only query public anime lists (with +18 / Safe Mode filter enabled by default). For fast offline operation, data is stored locally in your browser (localStorage and IndexedDB), with no advertising cookies or third-party trackers. Cloud account creation is optional and syncs only linked accounts confirmed by you (Supabase infrastructure in sa-east-1 and US subprocessors such as GitHub Pages and Google OAuth under Standard Contractual Clauses — SCCs). You can clear local data, unlink providers, revoke OAuth access in your Google account, or permanently delete your cloud account and data at any time in Settings.
legal.termsText: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of continuous availability. To create a cloud sync account, you must be 16 years of age or older (LGPD Art. 14 / GDPR Art. 8).
legal.contactText: Data Controller: Wagner Santos. For LGPD/GDPR requests, privacy questions, or copyright takedown notices (DMCA), use the official channel on GitHub:

landing.faq_q1: Do I need to create an account or provide my password?
landing.faq_a1: No. AniMatch uses public data from your profile on AniList, Kitsu, or MyAnimeList. Logging in is 100% optional and only serves to store your accounts for quick access across devices.
landing.faq_q2: What does the Match score mean?
landing.faq_a2: It is a personalized estimate of the score you would give to that anime (from 0 to 10). It cross-references anime genres, themes, and studios with your real ratings of completed titles.
landing.faq_a3_intro: The Match score combines two things:
landing.faq_a3_item1_text: — calculated with Bayesian smoothing. This avoids statistical distortions: if you only rated 1 Mecha anime with a 10, the algorithm doesn't assume you love Mecha above all else, but balances it against your overall average rating.
landing.faq_a3_item2_text: — the average score of the anime on AniList/Kitsu/MyAnimeList.
landing.faq_a3_conclusion: The final score displayed on the card is an 85/15 weighted average: 85% comes from your personal Match and 15% from the community score. Highly rated recommendations get a slight boost, but what truly decides is what fits you.
landing.faq_a4: By default, all processing and storage occur in the visitor's browser (IndexedDB and localStorage), including recent searches for quick autofill. You can clear this history anytime by clicking "Clear history" below the search form. No personal data is ever commercialized.
